Recommendations, not rules: they let other operators recognize the station type from the callsign. Tap a line to use it.

A tracker without messages or voice should use -12, not -9 (-9 suggests someone who answers). For special activity (satellite, event, 6 m tests) use -6 to keep it apart from the everyday -9. -1 to -4 and -15 are generic for operators with several stations.
Source: APRS SSID Recommendations, WB4APR (Bob Bruninga), 2012.
